prior_solution.where: The cipher ledger read R5504 page 1, lines 1 to 16, on 15 November 2026 (targets/sforza1598/NOTES.md). The archive's key sheet R5347 (DECODE) is a key, not a reading; I used it for family A.

solution.what: My own transcription of the DECODE images of these pages, as sign labels.
A key from the cipher text alone for each page or group of pages from ciphertext.
The key applied to the rows, sign by sign; the frozen read kept apart. No reading in sentences.
